title: San Juan de Ortega to Burgos

moments.label: Atapuerca Archaeological Site
moments.text: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Earliest known European human remains (800,000+ years old).

moments.label: Burgos
moments.text: Historic capital of Castile. Major rest day stop.

moments.label: Burgos Cathedral
moments.text: UNESCO World Heritage Site. First Gothic cathedral in the Crown of Castile (1221).

stage.name: San Juan de Ortega to Burgos
stage.narrative: You pass through Atapuerca, where archaeologists found the oldest human remains in Europe — 800,000 years of human presence in this hillside. The long approach into Burgos takes you through suburbs and industrial zones, and the contrast is deliberate: deep time beside modern sprawl. By the time you stand before the cathedral's Gothic spires, you are carrying a strange awareness that walking is the oldest human act, and that your footsteps are neither the first nor the last.
stage.closing: What does it mean to you that humans have walked this land for hundreds of thousands of years?
